keywords: ERC-8350 agent 记忆状态登记
summary: 周日较安静。EIP-8015（移除 deposit 与 eth1data 字段）被提议纳入 Hegotá 并合并到 EIP-8081。Caspar Schwarz-Schilling 发布 Ethlabs 的周更。ERC-8350 提出 agent 记忆的可验证版本控制，记忆内容不上链。Eli Ben-Sasson 发布面向非技术读者的 ZK-STARK 解读。

items.title: EIP-8081：提议纳入 EIP-8015
items.note: （etan-status）合并。据 Ethereal news #32，EIP-8015 移除 deposit 与 eth1data 字段，已在 ACDC #183 上提出。
items.note_en: (etan-status), merged. Per Ethereal news #32, EIP-8015 removes deposit and eth1data fields and was raised at ACDC #183.

summary_en: A quiet Sunday. EIP-8015 (removing deposit and eth1data fields) was proposed for Hegotá and merged into EIP-8081. Caspar Schwarz-Schilling posted Ethlabs' weekly update. ERC-8350 proposes verifiable version control for agent memory without putting memory content onchain. Eli Ben-Sasson published a non-technical ZK-STARK explainer.
